segs.text: For decades, factory robots have worked behind a fence. People on one side. Machines on the other.
parts: For decades, factory robots have worked behind a fence.
People on one side. Machines on the other.

segs.text: This week, South Korea cleared twenty humanoid robots to work beside people.
parts: This week, South Korea cleared twenty humanoid robots to work beside people.

segs.text: They'll clean chip-packaging components, position car body parts, stack shipyard brackets, and move refrigerated packaging.
The old safety rules assumed robots that stay in one place. Humanoids walk around.
parts: The old safety rules assumed robots that stay in one place.

segs.text: Data from the trial is meant to help rewrite those rules.
parts: Data from the trial is meant to help rewrite those rules.

segs.text: The caveat: this is permission to test, not proof that they work. What matters is how often a person has to step in.
parts: The caveat: this is permission to test, not proof that they work.
What matters is how often a person has to step in.

segs.text: The lesson for builders: trust is earned in small, measured trials. That's how the fence comes down.
